notes.title: Dev Blog #5: Second Sun's Classes
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Sunborn,[/h3]

Stepping into the treacherous lands of Rowen means you’ll have to be prepared for a fight. 

To do so, you’ll have to [b]choose between three different classes: Sentinel, Marauder or Diviner[/b]. Each one of them affords different playstyles, while offering unique challenges! But which one should you choose? Let’s take a closer look at the three classes in Second Sun, so you’ll be fully prepared to throw yourself into battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/97809401342f0cc8e7ccfbf91b5989cb484861b2.png[/img]
[i][b]“Light as a feather, faster than the wind”[/b][/i]

The Sentinel is a [b]warrior trained to fight in both close- and long-range battles[/b]. With a [b]crossbow [/b]in hand and a [b]pistol [/b]in their pocket, they tread through the lands, prepared for any enemy to attack. Their quick thinking skills make them essential on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/127e06cd81a103ff8e1b05bc5e38d966fbb17f4f.png[/img]
[i][b]“Molded by battle, trained to destroy”[/b][/i]

The Marauder is a [b]versatile frontline soldier[/b], who has trained for many years to become the master gunslinger they are today. You start out with a [b]rifle [/b]and a [b]revolver[/b], ready to destroy anything that crosses your path. Their fearless nature makes their enemies shake in terror.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/81fb702ecaaca584ae2e90c1533c11c9af3ceb4b.png[/img]
[i][b]“Obliterate all evil, one heretic at a time”[/b][/i]

The Diviner is a [b]mighty fighter who uses the divine light of the White Sun to charge into battle[/b]. While they can still use guns and other weapons, [b]they wield an assortment of powerful weapons[/b] that require the White Sun's blessings, as well as very powerful spells. To be able to channel the divine light and direct it to their enemies, the Diviner uses [b]an ember staff.[/b]

Whether you silently stalk your prey, charge into battle guns blazing, or channel the divine light – there’s a path for every warrior in Second Sun. Which one will you take when the Empire calls?

Choose wisely,

The Second Sun Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085620/Second_Sun/

notes.title: The Demo is Back!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Sunborn,[/h3]

The festive season is upon us!

It’s been a great year for Second Sun. Since our initial announcement in May, we have been [b]very grateful of the support we have gotten from all of you[/b], and have worked tirelessly to incorporate your feedback into the final version of the game. We have shared a lot of the behind-the-scenes action here in our dev blog and [b]gotten to be a part of cool events such as the October 2024 Steam Next Fest![/b]

Since we are bursting with holiday cheer, we have decided to[b] bring back the Second Sun Demo from the Next Fest! And as an extra treat, this demo is here to stay for now.[/b] Consider it our little Christmas present in advance - from us to you. 

As we close out the year, we’d like to thank all of you one last time. Without you, there would be no game (or at least not as good a game), and for that, you have our greatest appreciation.

Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year
[b]The Second Sun Team[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085620/Second_Sun/

notes.title: Second Sun: A grand new adventure, coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43794478/3d68e50d78a017bb0bddac1315f52b0a4d2c83c9.png[/img]

In the dim, foreboding shadow of the [b]Second Sun[/b], amidst the whispers of lost souls, the cultists are on the verge of victory. You stand as the last beacon of hope in a world about to be consumed by darkness. 

Unravel the story in this brand new [b]First-Person Shooter Role Playing Game[/b] (FPS RPG). Second Sun offers high-octane boomer shooter-like action where enemies explode in glorious mountains of [b]loot [/b]for you to use. A sprawling open world awaits you!  

Develop your Sunborn in line with your vision. Use a wide range of weapon types, level up skills, and find or craft the gear that matches your play-style. 

[b]Want a first taste? Check out the reveal trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=zUTASzu5x2g;full]https://youtu.be/zUTASzu5x2g[/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Key Features: [/b][/h3][list]
[*] Enjoy the fast-paced combat
[*] Battle your way through the randomly generated dungeons
[*] Fight, loot and upgrade your gear and abilities
[*] Explore a beautifully crafted open map
[*] Customise your character, choose your class and join the Empire![/list]
[h3][b]Stay up to date![/b][/h3]
Don't miss any Second Sun news by joining our community. We’re eager to share more about the game over the coming months. So keep up to date with all the news on our social media channels below, or by clicking the ‘Follow’ button on the Steam page!
